audit_findings.why_raw_forecast_loss_is_large: In raw clinical units, Systolic Blood Pressure (variance=415.4756) and Heart Rate (variance=374.4585) contribute 94.68% of the unnormalized MSE loss, while Body Temperature (variance=6.364) contributes only 0.76%. Consequently, raw MSE loss is dominated by SBP/HR units (~6,800).
audit_findings.standardization_solution: Implemented Train-Only Channel Variance Scaling: each channel's squared error is divided by sigma_{train, c}^2 (computed strictly from the training cohort). This guarantees that all 5 physiological vitals contribute equally (20.0% each) to backpropagation gradients, bringing the standardized forecast loss to an expected baseline of ~1.0, matching the scale of classification heads.
audit_findings.preservation_of_clinical_units: All user-facing dashboards, API endpoints, evaluation reports, and test set benchmarks continue to report MAE and RMSE in original clinical units (BPM, %, mmHg, breaths/min, °C).
